groups.problem: In EventManager.create, mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration is accessed without optional chaining, so it throws a TypeError when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All six point at the same line and the same missing `?.`, and all propose the same fix.

groups.problem: In GoogleCalendarService updateEvent/deleteEvent, the fallback find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId) only runs when externalCalendarId is falsy, so it can never match and the calendarId is left undefined.
groups.rationale: The same broken fallback was copied into updateEvent and deleteEvent. Several suggestions name both places, and one change of approach fixes both.

groups.problem: The Calendar interface's createEvent now requires a credentialId, but the Lark, Office365 and other Calendar implementations still declare createEvent(event) and ignore the credential when picking the calendar.
groups.rationale: All of these report the same signature/contract mismatch with the new credentialId parameter, either per implementation or at the interface, and the fix is to update each implementation the same way.
